about: One entry per release tag. kind: "fix" (doesn't change how Charles trades) or "rule" (does, or might). The dashboard's Updates card and charles-update read this; see docs/releases.md.

notes: Kalshi: a copied bet now costs exactly what the bet it copies cost, using part-contracts in the practice books, so Charles, Evil Charles and your account match to the cent until bets finish.
Kalshi: bets count at what they cost. A $20 bet takes $20 off your account, and a win puts back the stake plus the profit.
Kalshi: when Evil Charles takes the other side, he spends as close to Charles's stake as whole contracts allow, so both bots' values match until bets finish.
Kalshi: each part of the graph's line is blue or red by whose bet moved it. A win from a Charles bet rises in blue even while you follow Evil Charles.
Kalshi: the graph starts at your $1,000, and the win rate counts bets won out of bets finished.
Kalshi: Charles and Evil Charles now both bet on every scan, each with its own practice $1,000, so each builds its own record.
Kalshi: your account follows the bot you pick. One graph shows your account, blue while it follows Charles and red while it follows Evil Charles.
Kalshi: strategies bet from the first scan, with no waiting period. The weather minimum edge is back to 7c.
The tour, now with Charles talking you through Home and the Leaderboard, starts by itself only on a new install. Settings can replay it.
Leaderboard: a Reset button, and a new install's first day says when its chart starts.
Plan vs SPY is measured at the same market close everywhere, so after-hours prices no longer skew it.
Alerts show the whole message when opened, and old or false alarms clear themselves.
The first official release. From here on, updates and Restore work by version.
New dashboard: one Home for every bot, with sliders and Copy on the Plan tab, a side feed, alerts and a short tour.
The dashboard is private with a one-time login link, served over HTTPS on a fresh install.
Pause and Resume, the leaderboard and monthly challenges, and an optional chat on your own Anthropic key.
A new install runs stocks only. Crypto and Kalshi are add-ons.
Notices now appear on the dashboard.
